opening_message:
Ticket 1: Donna Ball (employee ID E024) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E024.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Full-time Payroll Specialist. Requested write access to Source Code. Full-time employees may have up to write; admin is only for the role that owns the system, so write is the maximum here. Recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB lists E024 as a contractor with basic training (HR note said full-time, but Security DB is authoritative for employment type). Contractors with basic training max out at read. Requested write exceeds max, so recommend granting read.

Under policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training. Since E024 has only basic training, the maximum access to Source Code is read. The requested write exceeds the maximum, so the granted level is read.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee E024 (Donna Ball) requests write access to Source Code.

Two notes in team memory:
- Note 1 (HR): role Payroll Specialist, employment type full_time, recommendation for Source Code: write. Full-time employees max write (unless role owns system; Payroll Specialist doesn't own Source Code, Engineer does). So write is maximum.
- Note 2 (Security): role Payroll Specialist, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation: read. Contractors with basic training max out at read. Requested write exceeds max, so recommend read.

Conflict: HR says full-time, Security says contractor and claims Security DB is authoritative for employment type.

The Security agent's note says Security DB is authoritative for employment type. The policy: contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin. This contractor has basic training, so max is read. Requested write exceeds max, so grant read.

So the decision should be read, based on the contractor employment type with basic security training.

I'll submit decision: read.
